title: Future active
subtitle: A sigma often announces a future form.
overview: Many future active forms use σ plus primary active endings: λύσω, λύσεις, λύσει.
A future is not always a simple prediction; context can show promise, warning, or command-like force.

sections.title: λύσω: future active
rows: we / you all / they will loose

items.en: He or she will see the light.
He or she will be with us.
